import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static List<Long>[] pos = new ArrayList[10];
    static long cnt2 = -1;
    static long n;
    static long[] pw = new long[15];
    static long[] s = new long[15];
    static int res = 0;
    static int cnt = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            pos[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            // Initialize pos[i], will be sorted later
        }
        pw[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 13; i++) {
            pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
        }

        // DFS to generate numbers
        dfs(0, 0);

        // Sort pos arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(pos[i]);
        }

        // DFS2 to process
        dfs2(0);

        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static long query(int fixpre, long val) {
        long total = 0;
        for (int d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
            long offset = (val - fixpre * pw[d]) % MOD;
            if (offset < 0) offset += MOD;
            int p = lowerBound(pos[d], MOD - offset);
            long size = pos[d].size();
            total = (total + s[d] + offset * size - MOD * (size - p)) % MOD;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void dfs(long val, int d) {
        int x = (int)((cnt - val + MOD) % MOD);
        pos[d].add((long) x);
        cnt++;
        s[d] += x;
        if (d == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs(val * 10 + i, d + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long val) {
        if (val * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && val * 10000000 > n) {
            res = (res + (int)(query((int)val, cnt2 + 1) % MOD)) % (int)MOD;
            cnt2 += cnt;
        } else {
            cnt2++;
            res = (res + (int)(((cnt2 - val) % MOD + MOD) % MOD)) % (int)MOD;
            int start = (val != 0) ? 0 : 1;
            for (int i = start; i < 10; i++) {
                long newVal = val * 10 + i;
                if (newVal <= n) {
                    dfs2(newVal);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
